hi,

i have red the user guide of the package and i don't know if i have understood correclty the pcr bias thing.

if i run the descriptive statistics on the coverage i have only one peack but on the right side of the histogram. could it be explained by the fact that i have high coverage, or this means that my data are highly suffering from pcr bias? what i mean is if i have just one peack but on the right side instead of the left size this could be ok or not?

PS. this "problem" still remains even if i filter and then normilise my data.

thank you

Matilde De Luca

messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion]
parts:
a secondary peak on the right side of the histogram could indicate PCR bias, you can filter the high coverage reads. We don't have any other way to deal with this at the moment.

Best,
Altuna
